glue_rte_active_selection.description: Active model selection on GLUE RTE (87 candidates, 2 classes) with a 100-label budget: the paper's main cumulative-regret comparison (Table 1).
glue_rte_active_selection.note: Scaled setup: every task's items are split into two halves balanced in class mix and per-model error. Selectors run on one half with the paper's 100-label budget, 5 seeds and the full candidate pool; the visible half is data/benchmarks/<task>_train.json, the held-out half (labels, candidate order and item order hidden) lives only in eval/test/. Paper numbers below are the paper's full-pool values (Tables 1, 3, 4, 5) and are kept unchanged.

cumulative_regret_at_100.description: Total excess error (percentage points summed over rounds 1-100) of the model selected in each round, over a 100-label budget. Lower is better.

cumulative_regret_at_25.description: Cumulative excess error over rounds 1-25: catches selectors that only recover late.

initial_regret.description: Excess error of the model selected before any label is revealed.

instant_regret_at_50.description: Excess error of the model selected after round 50.

instant_regret_at_100.description: Excess error of the model selected after round 100 (end of budget).

near_optimal_at_100.description: Fraction of seeds whose round-100 selection is within one percentage point of the best candidate.

label_budget.description: Labels actually revealed by the evaluator's oracle (mean over seeds); a selector may stop early and keep its selection. Cannot exceed 100.
